about.p1: I am a developer passionate about creating exceptional user interfaces. My goal is to merge aesthetic design with cutting-edge technical performance.
about.p2: With a strong background in modern web development, I build scalable and interactive applications that provide a memorable user experience.
about.p3: Always keeping up with technology, I love pushing the boundaries of what is possible on the web, using the latest animations and architectures.

skills.subtitle: Technologies and tools I work with every day to bring your projects to life.

projects.subtitle: A selection of my recent work. Each project has been designed to provide the best possible user experience.
projects.inadia_desc: Premium e-commerce site developed with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Firebase (Auth, Database, and Storage). The platform provides an ultra-responsive checkout flow with real-time order tracking and state management.
projects.p1_desc: Modern showcase site for a consulting agency, featuring an ISO certification catalog and an interactive, animated quote request system. The architecture emphasizes brand authority and seamless lead generation.
projects.p2_desc: Interactive 3D sneaker experience built with Next.js, Three.js, and GSAP for an immersive product showcase. Users can freely manipulate the model in full 360 degrees and inspect every technical detail in real time.
projects.p3_desc: An immersive and refined web experience designed for a gourmet establishment, highlighting culinary art through subtle animations. Every interaction evokes luxury and elegance to entice guests to book an unforgettable table.
projects.p4_desc: Modern online store for an artisanal coffee roaster, offering a seamless coffee selection experience and a dynamic interactive cart. A warm aesthetic that highlights artisanal roasting while optimizing every step of the order process.
projects.p5_desc: Smartwatch product page combining an immersive carousel, custom cursor, and GSAP-driven storytelling. A futuristic presentation engineered to captivate visitors and highlight advanced connected features.

testimonials.subtitle: Feedback from clients satisfied with my work.
testimonials.t1_text: An exceptional collaboration. Mouhamed understood our vision and delivered a digital showcase that perfectly reflects our firm's expertise. Highly recommended!
testimonials.t2_text: An exceptional online store. Mouhamed successfully combined a Premium design with ultra-smooth navigation. The shopping experience is flawless, and our sales have taken off!
testimonials.t3_text: A true driving force. Mouhamed's attention to detail and technical mastery brought our project to life well beyond our initial expectations.
